U.S. Department of Energy, Advanced Manufacturing Office (2012). Adjustable Speed Drive Part-Load Efficiency. Energy Tips: Motor Systems, Motor Systems Tip Sheet #11. DOE/GO-102012-3730, November 2012.

Two-page tip sheet; year verified on the sheet (November 2012). Locators are PDF pages (no printed page numbers). Main file: PWM VFD efficiency at 100% load for drive ratings 5-200 hp (95-97%); the part-load values (1.6-75% of rated output) are in _other-values (efficiency 88-95% at 25% load, 80-89% at 12.5%, 35-61% at 1.6%). Drive-only efficiency, not motor or system; the existing motor_variable-speed efficiency row (JRC 2009, 96-97%) is on the same basis. Table reprinted from Saftronics, Inc.
